// FORM 3 OF 3, AND THE ONE A NAIVE GATE MISSES: the receive happens inside a
// selector callback, on the CLOSURE PARAMETER rather than on the channel variable.
// Nothing in this function body reads `ch` after the AddReceive, so a gate that
// looked only for `<seeded var>.Receive` would see a channel with no receive at all
// and report nothing.
//
// The live form is deliveryactivity.go:2009-2024 (routeSignals) and :3462
// (requestMainWriteLease's grant arm); the pump's park uses it three times.
package badaddreceive

const signalActivityFinished = "activityFinished"

type activityFinishedSignal struct {
	ActivityID string
	Outcome    string
}

func BadAddReceive(ctx workflow.Context) {
	ch := workflow.GetSignalChannel(ctx, signalActivityFinished)
	sel := workflow.NewSelector(ctx)
	sel.AddReceive(ch, func(c workflow.ReceiveChannel, _ bool) {
		var s activityFinishedSignal
		c.Receive(ctx, &s) // WANT: flagged — the closure param IS the same channel
		_ = s
	})
	sel.Select(ctx)
}
